cohort: 62 neonates (mean gestational age 31.6 weeks and mean birth weight 1620g) hospitalized in a neonatal intensive care unit
finding: Neonates with necrotizing enterocolitis exhibited faster clot formation and greater clot strength compared to those with sepsis and healthy neonates.
mod_finding: The study matched neonates with necrotizing enterocolitis, sepsis, and healthy controls 1:1:1 with regards to delivery mode, but the abstract does not report any findings related to mode of delivery.
